data.content: We have been continuously supporting Prishtina Municipality's activities and events throughout the years, creating brands and designing various materials for various events. Our desire is to help make our city better, and the following is a collection of pro-bono work we produced.
We created a brand for the Prishtina Mobile Market, a recent Prishtina Municipality activity in support of local producers coming from the rural area of the town.
The market moves to different neighbourhoods around Prishtina, making its products available for all citizens.
It has become a tradition for children to participate in the reading week, organised by Prishtina Municipality every year, starting on the International Children's Day, June 1st of every year.
We have branded and designed all the promotional material for this activity, supporting the young readers of Prishtina.

Due to the lack of any information facilities for the bus routes of Prishtina's Public Transport, we decided to design the existing bus route map using the technique now popular all over the world, that of Harry Beck's London Underground map of 1931.
We are in the process of updating the map with the new routes.
